commands.name: list-categories
commands.summary: List all forum categories with id, slug, description and topic/post counts. Use slug and id with list-category-topics.

commands.name: list-category-topics
commands.summary: List topics in one category, newest activity first by default, with optional sort and paging. posters[] gives user ids; the entry whose description contains 'Original Poster' is the starter.

commands.name: list-category-hot-topics
commands.summary: List currently hot (trending) topics in one category.

commands.name: list-latest-topics
commands.summary: List the most recently active topics across all categories, with optional sort and paging.

commands.name: list-hot-topics
commands.summary: List currently hot (trending) topics across all categories.

commands.name: get-topic
commands.summary: Get one topic: title, starter (details.created_by), counts, and its first ~20 posts. Post bodies are HTML in posts[].cooked.

commands.name: search
commands.summary: Full-text search of topics and posts. Filters go inside the term, e.g. 'category:support', 'order:latest', '@username', 'status:solved', 'in:first'.

commands.name: get-user-card
commands.summary: Get a user's profile summary: name, join date, last post/seen times, trust level, admin/moderator flags and badge count.
